_description: Manifest schema for sensor assets. Each entry is a single asset. Copy this template and fill in the fields. Required fields are marked with // REQUIRED.

_example_entries.subject: ground-station-04
_example_entries.operator_note: Operator traced the conveyor alignment from the point cloud.

_example_entries.subject: esmeraldas-coast
_example_entries.operator_note: Flood extent visible in the speckle signature.

_schema_fields.id: REQUIRED — unique slug matching the filename without extension
_schema_fields.path: REQUIRED — absolute web path from public/ root
_schema_fields.sensor: REQUIRED — one of: lidar, sar, rf, eo, splat, multispectral, composite
_schema_fields.instrument: REQUIRED — instrument metadata line for the caption
_schema_fields.subject: REQUIRED — what the asset shows (slug form)
_schema_fields.notation: OPTIONAL — notation mark details. Set to null if no notation applied.
_schema_fields.license: REQUIRED — from controlled vocabulary. Never null on published entries.
_schema_fields.used_on_pages: OPTIONAL — where the asset appears. Updated by the build.
_schema_fields.status: REQUIRED — one of: draft, review, published, retired
_schema_fields.source: REQUIRED — source metadata with type and origin
